pages.title: Can Claude edit PDFs? Merge, split and stamp pages
pages.answer: Partly. Claude reads PDFs well, but in most apps it cannot hand back a changed PDF on its own. Connect the PDF server (free token) and Claude merges, splits, reorders, rotates and stamps pages as named tools, and every tool writes a new file. pages.title: Can Claude track prices? A watch list with history
pages.answer: Not on its own. With web search on, Claude can find a price once, but it keeps no dated price history to compare later. Connect the Price Tracker server (free token) and Claude reads a product page, adds it to a watch list with a target price, stores every check and tells you what dropped. Checks run when you ask. Nothing polls in the background.
native: Finds a current price with web search.
Compares two products you name.
needs: A stored price history for each item.
A target price and a list of items that reached it.
One refresh of the whole list in a single call.

example.prompt: What does this book cost right now?
example.result:
Title: A Light in the Attic | Books to Scrape - Sandbox
Price: 51.77 GBP
Confidence: low (source regex-fallback)
URL: https://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/a-light-in-the-attic_1000/index.html
Checked: 2026-11-05T12:18:47.908Z
Change: no earlier observation stored for this URL. Use watch_add to start tracking it.
example.note: books.toscrape.com is a public practice shop. Low confidence means the price came from a text match, not from structured data on the page.

example2.prompt: Watch it and tell me when it is 45 or less.
example2.result:
Watching A Light in the Attic as 38b93dad.
Price now: 51.77 GBP
Confidence: low (source regex-fallback)
Target: 45.00 GBP
Checks run when you ask: there is no background job and nothing polls this page. Say "refresh my watches" (watch_refresh) at the start of a session, then alerts_pending lists the drops and target hits.
Kept for your token on this endpoint, not on a disk you can open: watch_list shows it again, and the data is held for 30 days and refreshed for another 30 on every write.

faq.q: Does it check prices every day?
faq.a: No. It checks when you ask. Say refresh my watches at the start of a session, then alerts_pending lists the drops.

faq.q: What if a shop blocks it?
faq.a: price_add_manual stores a price you read yourself, so the history stays complete.

pages.title: Can Claude schedule recurring invoices? Yes, with a tool
pages.answer: Not alone. Claude does not wake up on the first of the month, and it keeps no billing schedule or invoice numbers between chats. Connect the Recurring server (free token) and Claude stores a client, line items and cadence for each repeating invoice, lists what falls due, and creates a numbered invoice in the Invoice server for each due period when you ask.
native: Drafts an invoice when you ask.
Works out billing dates by hand.
needs: A saved schedule per client with cadence and due days.
A list of what falls due in the next weeks.
Real numbered invoices for every due period.

example.prompt: Bill Harbor Dental 350 USD for hosting on the 1st of each month from December, due in 14 days.
example.result:
Created schedule c8834a29 for Harbor Dental, monthly from 2026-12-01.

{

  "tax": [],

  "currency": "USD",
  "start_date": "2026-12-01",
  "end_date": null,
  "status": "active",
  "next_due": "2026-12-01",
  "auto_generate": false,
  "items": 1,
  "next_dates": [
    "2026-12-01",

    "2027-02-01"

Nothing is invoiced yet. Run invoice_generate_due when you want the due invoices created. Month steps keep 2026-12-01's day of month and clamp it to shorter months. The free tier allows 3 active schedules.

No business profile yet: generated PDFs show a placeholder issuer. Run business_set {name, address, vat_id, iban} in the invoice server (mcp-invoice) and render again.

example2.prompt: What is due in the next 90 days?
example2.note: The server answers in JSON. These fields are unchanged.

faq.a: No. invoice_generate_due creates them in the Invoice server. You send the PDF yourself.
Three active schedules. Billing on a fixed day of the month is Pro.
